label: Sprint Demo Preparation
description: Creates structured demo scripts from completed sprint stories. Defines demo flow, talking points, success criteria to showcase, and anticipated questions.

guidedInputs.label: Sprint name / number
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Sprint 24, Q1 Week 6, March Sprint

guidedInputs.label: Product or system name
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Customer Portal, Payments Service, Internal Analytics Platform

guidedInputs.label: Completed user stories / tickets
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List completed stories. Include title, acceptance criteria if available, and any notable details.
Example:
- US-101: As a customer, I can reset my password via email link (AC: Email sent within 60s, link valid 24h)
- US-102: Fix: Payment retry logic no longer double-charges on timeout
- US-105: Admin dashboard now shows real-time active user count

guidedInputs.label: Sprint goal (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Complete user authentication flow, Deliver MVP payment integration

guidedInputs.label: Known issues or incomplete items
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Mobile responsive layout not yet implemented, Export to PDF is slow on large datasets, Story US-107 moved to next sprint
